description: January 27 birthday meaning: Aquarius decan 1, birthday number 9, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a January 27 birthday falls in Aquarius, in the first decan, with Uranus as the sign's ruler and Uranus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 9. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aquarius is fixed and air.

sections.heading: Personality of a January 27 birthday
paragraphs: Late January's 27th reduces to 9, the number most associated with idealism and compassion, and it sits in a sign already famous for humanitarian ideals. With the Sun around seven degrees into Aquarius and Uranus sub-ruling the decan, this birthday often reads as a principled free thinker who feels personally responsible for the wider world.

By noon UTC on January 27, the Sun has normally reached roughly 7° of Aquarius. That places the date in the Aquarius decan that astrologers give to Uranus, the first of three. Uranus, the modern ruler of Aquarius, also governs its opening decan, from about January 21 to January 29. This is traditionally the most independent and inventive part of the sign. Late-January birthdays are commonly linked with original thinkers, interested in the future, technology, social change and the freedom to be exactly themselves. Friendship tends to matter as much as romance, sometimes more. Doubled Uranus can bring a contrarian streak and an emotional detachment that others misread as coldness. Their gift is seeing possibilities ahead of the crowd and inviting others along without pressure.

sections.heading: Numerology of the January 27 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 27th, you carry the compound 2 + 7 = 9. The 2 adds sensitivity, the 7 adds depth and reflection, and the 9 that results is compassionate and wide-ranging. People born on this day are often described as wise beyond their years, drawn to teaching, counselling or creative work that helps others make sense of things. Their emotional insight can be striking. Taken as a secondary number, the 27 is traditionally associated with leadership through understanding rather than force. Accepting differing views with patience tends to strengthen their influence over time.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same January 27 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 1 for 1980, 11 for 1990, 3 for 2000 and 4 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: January 27 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: A January birthday arrives in the depths of northern winter, a season of short days, stock-taking and fresh resolutions; south of the equator it falls in high summer instead. Most of the month belongs to Capricorn, with Aquarius taking over around January 20. In numerology January is month 1, the number of beginnings and self-direction, which suits a birthday that sits right at the start of the calendar. January 27 is the 27th day of the year. In most years Pisces season is under way by February 19, 23 days after this birthday.

January 27 is a date where the Chinese animal genuinely depends on the year. Lunar New Year had arrived by this date in 26 of 121 years between 1924 and 2044; in the others the birth belongs to the previous animal. January 27 is also the birthday of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756), Lewis Carroll (1832) and Wilhelm II (1859).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is January 27?
faq.answer: January 27 is Aquarius in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Aquarius, which tradition links with Uranus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on January 27?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On January 27 the Life Path is 8 in 1960, 9 in 1970, 1 in 1980, 11 in 1990, 3 in 2000, 4 in 2010 and 5 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 9 for everyone born on the 27th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on January 27?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology needs care here, because Lunar New Year moves between January 21 and February 20. Across 1924 to 2044 it had passed by January 27 in 26 of 121 years, so the year page for your birth year settles it.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on January 27?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a January 27 birthday are Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756), Lewis Carroll (1832) and Wilhelm II (1859). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
